facts.text: Sonora Resort is located in the heart of the Discovery Island archipelago on the rugged West Coast of British Columbia.
facts.excerpt: Sonora Resort is located in the heart of the Discovery Island archipelago on the rugged West Coast of British Columbia.

facts.text: The resort is reached in 50 minutes by air from Vancouver, or by sea from Vancouver Island.
facts.excerpt: Travel 50 minutes by air from Vancouver or by sea from Vancouver Island to our remote sanctuary.

facts.text: The resort sits in an ancient British Columbia rainforest archipelago with eagles, whales and bears.
facts.excerpt: Experience world-class outdoor adventures in an ancient B.C. rainforest archipelago, filled with eagles, whales, bears, and more.

facts.text: Sonora became a member of Relais & Chateaux in 2009.
facts.excerpt: Sonora was welcomed as a proud member of the Relais & Châteaux family in 2009.
Enhance your meal with one of 1,500 bottles from our award-winning wine cellar.

facts.text: The resort's spa is Island Currents Spa, offering treatments and specialty therapies.
facts.excerpt: the treatments and specialty therapies at Island Currents Spa seek to soothe and revitalize

facts.text: Rooms, suites and villas use cedar and stone craftsmanship and picture windows, with views over the Yuculta Rapids and Innes Passage.
facts.excerpt: invite the outside in with cedar and stone craftsmanship, picture windows and views that overlook the Yuculta Rapids and Innes Passage

facts.text: Rooms are in ocean-facing lodges, each with common lounges, stone fireplaces and hot tubs.
facts.excerpt: Each lodge has a unique layout that includes common lounges, stone fireplaces and hot tubs throughout.

facts.text: Suites range from two to six bedrooms, with indoor and outdoor hot tubs, fireplaces and balconies overlooking sea lions in the kelp beds.
facts.excerpt: Sonora’s exquisite suites range in size from two to six bedrooms and are spread across our lovely ocean-facing lodges. Enjoy indoor and outdoor hot tubs, balconies that overlook sea lions playing in the kelp beds

facts.text: The private villas, Sea Lion Pointe House and Eagle Rock Lodge, are set in their own private locations with art collections, towering fireplaces and outdoor terraces.
facts.excerpt: Nestled in their own private locations, these villas are completely your own. Indulge in sumptuous luxury with the generous picture windows that frame the wilderness views. Surround yourself with impressive art collections, towering fireplaces and outdoor terraces.

facts.text: Guests can fish for Chinook in the channels and rapids of the Discovery Islands, hike old-growth rainforest and watch grizzly bears in their natural habitat.
facts.excerpt: Fish for Chinook amidst the swirling channels and rapids of the Discovery Islands. Hike through ancient, old-growth rainforests and watch Grizzly bears in their natural habitat.

facts.text: Experiences include helicopter adventures, ocean adventures cruising islands, inlets and waterfalls for wildlife, and guided wilderness adventures.
facts.excerpt: Cruise islands, inlets and waterfalls looking for local wildlife

facts.text: On-island activities include lake paddling, archery, trout pond fishing and guided hikes.
facts.excerpt: Lake paddling, archery, trout pond fishing & guided hikes

facts.text: Facilities include an outdoor heated pool, rooftop hot tubs, mineral pools, a covered indoor tennis court, a movie theatre, a nine-hole putting green, virtual golf, fly-fishing ponds, saunas and a fitness center.
facts.excerpt: Enjoy use of all of our resort facilities including the outdoor heated pool, rooftop hot tubs, mineral pools, covered indoor tennis court, movie theatre, nine-hole putting green, virtual golf, fly-fishing ponds, saunas and fitness center.

facts.text: The kitchen works with local suppliers for organic meats, locally caught seafood and micro-greens.
facts.excerpt: From organic meats and locally-caught seafood to tender micro-greens, our team works with local suppliers to source the finest and freshest ingredients.

facts.text: The resort works with its local community and Indigenous partners for its guest experiences.
facts.excerpt: We proudly support our local community and indigenous partners, curating the best knowledge and expertise for our guests.
